summary: Persisted Telegram update offsets before /gateway_restart triggers by adding an awaitable onUpdateProcessed callback to registerGatewayRestartCommand, invoking it with ctx.update.update_id immediately after accepted decision and before sentinel/restart calls, and threading opts.updateOffset.onUpdateId through bot-native-commands. Updated gateway-restart tests to include update_id in ctx, pass/mock onUpdateProcessed, and assert it is called with the correct update ID before sentinel write and restart trigger. Verification passed: pnpm vitest run src/telegram/gateway-restart.test.ts, pnpm build, pnpm lint.
